## Key DwC fields: Event core

Largely the same terms — sorted by what each one describes

:::: {.columns .fields}

::: {.column width="50%"}
[Event table]{.table-name}

[Required]{.field-label}

- `eventID` — <span class="small-note">unique, stable ID</span>
- `eventDate` — <span class="small-note">YYYY-MM-DD</span>
- `decimalLatitude`, `decimalLongitude`

[Strongly recommended]{.field-label}

- `minimumDepthInMeters`, `maximumDepthInMeters`
- `sampleSizeValue` <span class="small-note">(volume of sample)</span>
- `sampleSizeUnit` <span class="small-note">(units of volume sampled)</span>
- `samplingProtocol` <span class="small-note">(link to your SOP)</span>
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
[Occurrence extension]{.table-name}

[Required]{.field-label}

- `occurrenceID` — <span class="small-note">unique, stable ID</span>
- `eventID` — <span class="small-note">links the row to its event</span>
- `scientificName` — <span class="small-note">taxon name to lowest possible taxon rank</span>
- `basisOfRecord` = <span class="small-note">"MaterialSample"</span>
- `occurrenceStatus` = <span class="small-note">"present"</span>

[Strongly recommended]{.field-label}

- `scientificNameID` <span class="small-note">(WoRMS AphiaID)</span>
- `organismQuantity` <span class="small-note">(read count of sequence)</span>
- `organismQuantityType` = <span class="small-note">"DNA sequence reads"</span>
- `sampleSizeValue` <span class="small-note">(total read count in sample)</span>
- `sampleSizeUnit` = <span class="small-note">"DNA sequence reads"</span>
- `associatedSequences` <span class="small-note">(link to e.g. GenBank or ENA accession)</span>
:::

::::

::: {.fields-note}
`sampleSizeValue` and `sampleSizeUnit` sit in both tables and mean different things — volume at the event, read counts at the occurrence.
:::

::: {.notes}
Largely the same vocabulary, arranged differently. The depth fields are the one addition here — they belong to the sampling, not to a detection, so they only appear once an Event table exists.

Anything true of the sampling goes in the Event table once: where, when, how deep, how much water, which protocol. Anything true of a single detection goes in the Occurrence extension: which taxon, how many reads, which sequence. eventID appears in both, and is what joins them.

The payoff is that sampleSizeValue can now carry both meanings at once, one in each table, which it could not do on a single flat row.
:::
